support.limits: TV is distance between tokenizer-training byte mixtures, not a bound on hypernetwork generalization. Scheme LP allows all9 domain weights but keeps current fixed within-domain ratios; pool distance ignores other settings.

reward.method: 5-fold held-out-batch prediction, stratified within500-update blocks. Ridge1e-4, time bins and settings-by5k-phase interactions. Bucket counts replay seed42 after16 initial queue draws; verify against saved final checkpoint RNG before interpretation. Associations are descriptive, not causal or out-of-tokenizer validation.

nonlinear_reward.method: Histogram gradient boosting:100 trees,15 leaves,min leaf50,L2=5,5-fold CV. Descriptive prediction of observed policy advantage; unmodeled interactions or text difficulty remain. Held-out-tokenizer folds keep each pool ID entirely outside its training folds.

feature_audit.limits: Lower-bound form availability in vocabularies of22 compression-selected training members, not all1000 or proof of useful gradient exposure. Form-only matches omit priors; prior-range matches require the same form and interpolation within observed min/max priors. These metrics do not measure co-occurrence/context coverage.

medical_token_audit.limits: Exact native vocabulary-string membership, not proof of gradient exposure. Different strings can share a truncated feature tuple; this query does not exhaustively encode all1000 vocabularies.

screen.limits: Exploratory48-tokenizer utility-selected screen, not population coverage. Per-case intervals unadjusted for432 comparisons. Domain effects are equal-case means with shared source-document bootstrap, one training seed per method. Policy correlations use only22 compression-selected pool members and nine domains, not the actual full training reward.
